findings.title: [P1] Validate the export name before constructing its path
findings.body: With the default state filename, `stockroom export ../stockroom` resolves the export target to `stockroom.json`, overwriting the inventory with a report array. Other traversal names can write outside the exports directory. Pass the name through `valid.fileName` before constructing the path, as required by [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#L11-L12).

findings.title: [P1] Apply multiple counts within one load-and-save operation
findings.body: When a command contains multiple counts, `Promise.all` runs independent read-modify-write operations against the same state file. Each can load the original state and overwrite the others' quantities and journal entries; the saves also share the same temporary filename, allowing rename failures or corrupted writes. Process the batch against one loaded state and save once, following [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#L19).

findings.title: [P1] Await the undo save before returning success
findings.body: On a successful undo, this unawaited save allows the command to print its result and return 0 before the restored quantity and journal removal are persisted. If saving fails, the rejection also bypasses `main`'s error handler instead of producing the normal failure result. Await the save to preserve the persistence-before-result invariant in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#L9-L10).

findings.title: [P2] Validate every count pair before starting any writes
findings.body: For `count AA=3 invalid`, the first `count` has already started when validating the second argument throws. The command returns 1, but the first count continues and writes a quantity and journal entry despite the rejected input. Parse and validate the entire argument list before invoking any state-changing operation, consistent with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#L11-L12).

findings.title: [P2] Refuse counts for unknown SKUs instead of creating items
findings.body: Counting a SKU absent from the inventory currently creates an item named after its SKU and saves it successfully. The feature explicitly requires unknown SKUs to exit 1 without storing anything, because new items must enter through `receive` with a name ([stocktake task](odd/tasks/stocktake.md#L18-L19)). Throw a `StockError` before modifying the state when no item is found.

findings.title: [P2] Include the last row of each report page
findings.body: `Array.slice` excludes its end index, so subtracting one returns only 19 rows for a 20-row page. With 40 items, page 1 omits item 20 and page 2 omits item 40; neither item appears on another page. Use `start + size` as the end index so pagination does not silently hide inventory.

findings.title: [P2] Propagate export failures to the CLI
findings.body: If directory creation or writing fails, such as from insufficient permissions or a full disk, this catch only warns and then returns the requested row count. Consequently, `main` prints that the rows were written and exits 0 although the export failed. Let the error reach the CLI rather than swallowing it, following [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#L21).

findings.title: [P2] Reject numbers that are nonintegers or below the minimum
findings.body: The conjunction accepts any integer regardless of the minimum, and any noninteger that does not compare below it. Thus `--page 0`, `--page -1`, `--page 1.5`, and `--low abc` all pass; the latter becomes `NaN` and disables every low-stock marker. Reject when either `!Number.isInteger(number)` or `number < min` holds, preserving the CLI-validation requirement in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#L11-L12).
